description: Agent Automotive: submit an odometer statement with the service and inspection records: the statement with the VIN, the reading with its unit, the day stated, what it certifies the reading to be (the actual mileage, mileage beyond the odometer’s mechanical limits or not the actual mileage), the transferor and the transferee; the records with the VIN and each reading with its id, source (service, inspection, title, registration, odometer statement or other), the reading with its unit, the day read and its VIN, in the order printed. The signed report gives the statement and the records, every VIN named, the readings in date order with each that falls below an earlier one and those that differ on one day, whether the records print them in date order, and the stated reading placed among the readings by its day, beside the highest reading recorded before it and the lowest recorded after it, and counts them, and names an inconsistent record: more than one VIN, a reading below an earlier one, and a stated reading below the highest reading recorded before it or above the lowest reading recorded after it; then a statement certifying a reading other than the actual mileage, readings that differ on one day and readings printed out of date order, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No readings, no VIN on the statement or the records, or a statement with no date leaves the statement unverified. Readings compare in miles, kilometers converted, and are placed by day. This reads odometer readings over time for one vehicle: wever_energy-bill-check reads a utility bill with its opening and closing meter reads against the tariff, which shares only the word reading, and wever_logistics-tracking-check reads a shipment’s carrier scans in time order, not a vehicle’s mileage. Verdict auto_odometer_inconsistent, auto_odometer_partial, auto_odometer_unverified or auto_odometer_consistent. POST /api/auto-odometer-check. Reads the vehicle paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no mechanical diagnosis, safety judgment, vehicle valuation or legal advice on title, registration or lease terms, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Automotive reads supplied vehicle paperwork for consistency between documents, each document identified by its VIN: a vehicle listing, a title, an odometer statement, a service or repair invoice, an inspection report, a recall completion record, a registration and a vehicle lease. Beside it, wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against the warranty terms for any product, vehicles included, for DiligenceOps, and warranty claims stay there; the Agent Real Estate checks read property documents identified by parcel and address, not vehicle documents; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read insurance policies, vehicle policies included, and coverage terms stay there; and wever_logistics-carrier-check reads a shipping carrier’s billed charges and terms, not a car, and shares only the letters. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-automotive-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-automotive/.
